pages.title: Shade of Leonard
pages.text: Leonard is an old, dark name — the black goat of the sabbath, the lord at the crossroads of infernal commerce. His Shade does not wander freely; he must be forced into the world through the Witch's Cauldron.

pages.title: Summoning Ritual
pages.text: Heat the Witch's Cauldron over fire. Fill it with water. Dissolve $(item)Nether Wart$(), a $(item)Tear of the Goddess$(), $(item)Diamond Vapour$(), a $(item)Diamond$(), and a $(item)Nether Star$(), in that order, either by dropping each into the bowl or by sneak-stirring it in by hand. Hold a $(item)Witches' Hat$() and right-click the cauldron. No Gunpowder. The nearby altar must hold at least 10 000 power.$(br2)When the conditions are met, the Shade rises above the cauldron.

pages.title: Behaviour
pages.text: Leonard is neutral until struck. Once provoked, he retaliates and brands his attacker with a curse of withering that drains life over time.$(br2)At half strength, he calls forth $(item)Lost Souls$(). While those souls remain alive nearby, Leonard cannot be harmed.

pages.title: Lost Souls
pages.text: Three kinds of soul attend him.$(br2)$(bold)Green souls$() can be harmed by anything.$(br2)$(bold)Red souls$() resist everything but fire and explosions.$(br2)$(bold)Black souls$() resist everything except magic and potions.$(br2)Each drops a $(item)Subdued Spirit$() when destroyed.

pages.title: Reward
pages.text: A defeated Shade drops $(item)Leonard's Urn$() — a vessel of considerable infernal standing. Its precise uses in cauldron and infernal commerce await further investigation.$(br2)The encounter is costly but the standing it confers among creatures of the night is real.
